tools.name: lookup_oboe_fingering
tools.description: Look up Conservatory system oboe fingerings, Half-Hole register rules (Db5/D5/Eb5), Left F vs Forked F rules, and octave key switches.

tools.name: check_oboe_f_fingering_choice
tools.description: Determine whether to finger Regular Side F, Left F, or Forked F given the preceding and following notes so fingers never slide across keys.

tools.name: diagnose_oboe_reed_response
tools.description: Diagnose sharp/flat A440 pitch, hard attacks, or collapsed openings on North American long-scrape and European short-scrape oboe reeds.

tools.name: lookup_conservatory_oboe_trills
tools.description: Look up dedicated trill keys (C-D trill levers, Ab-Bb trill, Left Eb-E, Banana key C-Db) on full Conservatory oboes.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "lookup_oboe_fingering" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Look up full Conservatory system oboe fingerings, half-hole rules (Db5/D5/Eb5), Forked F vs Left F selection rules, and octave key transitions (1st, 2nd, 3rd octave keys)." → after: "Look up Conservatory system oboe fingerings, Half-Hole register rules (Db5/D5/Eb5), Left F vs Forked F rules, and octave key switches."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
